[EN] The tuwangis keep wandering out of their area. It was all fine and good until they started attacking our soldiers.

There's just nothing to be done about them! I can't talk to them, but killing them seems...extreme. They're almost people!"Is there no other way?"
[ES] Los tuwangis no paran de salir de su zona. Todo iba bien hasta que empezaron a atacar a nuestros soldados.

¡No hay nada que hacer con ellos! No puedo hablar con ellos, pero matarlos parece... extremo. ¡Son casi personas!"Is there no other way?"

[EN] Well, now that you mention it, I've heard rumors from herb gatherers here and there that there is actually a potion that allows the drinker to speak the tuwangi language.

If the ingredients I heard were right, I'll need {@LinkCreature:205#1023#Quagmire Herb Sap} and {@LinkCreature:5#5#Muddy Sporewalker Mucus}.

Not pleasant to handle, but easy enough to find. What do you say?
[ES] Bueno, ahora que lo mencionas, he oído rumores de recolectores de hierbas aquí y allá de que en realidad existe una poción que le permite al bebedor hablar el idioma tuwangi.

Si los ingredientes que escuché son correctos, necesitaré {@LinkCreature:205#1023#Quagmire Herb Sap} y {@LinkCreature:5#5#Muddy Sporewalker Mucus}.

No es agradable de manipular, pero es bastante fácil de encontrar. ¿Qué dices?

[EN] (This quagmire herb has fresh, healthy leaves. It looks to be exactly what you were asked to gather.)
[ES] (Esta hierba de ciénaga tiene hojas frescas y sanas. Parece ser exactamente lo que te pidieron que recolectaras.)

[EN] Wow. I forgot how terrible that stuff smelled! And you want me to do what with it? Hrm.

Well, since it's for Jaedon, go ahead and give it here.
[ES] Vaya. ¡Olvidé lo terrible que olía esa porquería! ¿Y quieres que haga qué con eso? Mjum.

Bueno, ya que es para Jaedon, adelante y dalo acá.

[EN] Do you have what I need?
[ES] ¿Tienes lo que necesito?
